generalNotes: Currently an Implementation Engineer at Rebuy.
Building a storefront debugging MCP server.
Usually writing Vue, TypeScript and Liquid.
Field verify all dimensions. Old habit.

projects.title: Storefront debugging MCP server
projects.description: A lot of my job is figuring out why something on a Shopify storefront is fighting with something else. This is an MCP server that gives an AI assistant the tools to do that digging on its own. It's my first real AI build, so I'm learning as I go.

projects.title: Cart V1 to V2 migration tool
projects.description: An internal tool that moves a merchant's shopping cart setup from V1 to V2. It cuts about four hours off every migration, which adds up fast when you're doing a lot of them.

projects.title: Zakaria
projects.description: An avatar community site with forums that a few friends and I run. I rebuilt the whole front end, moving it off Laravel Livewire and onto Vue with Inertia. A Silk Road themed redesign is up next.

projects.title: Mortgage paydown calculator
projects.description: A Python CLI that runs amortization schedules and compares different payment plans to find the one that pays the least interest.

projects.title: Plant-sharing app
projects.description: A mobile app for keeping journals on your plants, with care notes like how often to water and how much sun each one likes. You can share a journal with other people. Still early.

revisions.title: Implementation Engineer, Rebuy
revisions.description: Started as Launch Engineer (Front-End) and got renamed after a merit raise. I build custom front-end features for Shopify merchants in Vue, keep our reusable component library in shape, and sit in on post-sales calls to make sure what we promised is actually buildable. 167 merchant launches so far.

revisions.title: Software Support Engineer, Rebuy
revisions.description: Support engineering on live merchant stores. Mostly that meant digging into third-party integration conflicts and shipping the fix, with Jest tests, through a PR.

revisions.title: Contract Software Engineer, ConvertClick Digital Analytics
revisions.description: A few months of React Native work on their mobile app.

revisions.title: Student, then Teaching Assistant, Actualize
revisions.description: Went through the Full-Stack Web Development program (Ruby, Rails, JavaScript, React), then stuck around to help the next cohorts get through it.

revisions.title: Foreman, K & H Construction
revisions.description: Seven years running jobsites in home construction. The original build.

revisions.title: Open source, GitLab
revisions.description: I contribute when I have time. Got a merge request into the Google Play integration.
